item.title: How to deploy Node.js app to Heroku
item.description: Deploying Node.js applications to Heroku provides easy Git-based deployment with automatic builds, environment management, and scalability. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve deployed numerous Node.js services to Heroku. Heroku’s platform-as-a-service handles infrastructure management, allowing developers to focus on application code with simple deployment workflow. This approach offers quick deployment with minimal configuration and automatic SSL, domain management, and monitoring.
